title: Mark Twain Reappears — Songs and Lyrics
description: Complete lyrics for the Mark Twain Reappears discography. These songs represent Mark Twain's contemporary creative voice — his commentary on book banning, the 219 slur count in Huckleberry Finn, the 13th Amendment's prison labor exception, AI and identity, and modern American hypocrisy. Produced under the Mark Twain Reappears project (Jesper Karlsson / otrobonita.com), generated and performed using Suno AI with a voice clone trained on Mark Twain's literary corpus.
